description: This file defines the ObjectUtils class, which provides utility methods for manipulating JSON objects, such as checking for boolean and string entries, creating JSON objects from boolean values, and serializing boolean values to JSON strings.

classes.name: ObjectUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for JSON object manipulation, including checking for specific entries and creating JSON objects from boolean values.

methods.name: bool HasBooleanEntry(const JsonObject & obj,const string & key,bool & resultValue)
methods.description: Checks whether a JsonObject has a specified key with a boolean value, and retrieves that value if present.

methods.name: string CreateBooleanJsonString(const string & key,const bool value)
methods.description: Creates a JSON string representing a boolean key-value pair.

methods.name: JsonObject CreateBooleanObject(const string & key,const bool value)
methods.description: Creates a JsonObject with a single boolean key-value pair.

methods.name: void AddBooleanEntry(JsonObject & obj,const string & key,const bool value)
methods.description: Adds a boolean entry to a given JsonObject.

methods.name: bool HasStringEntry(const JsonObject & obj,const string & key,string & resultValue)
methods.description: Checks whether a JsonObject has a specified key with a string value, and retrieves that value if present.

methods.name: string BoolToJsonString(const bool value)
methods.description: Serializes a boolean value to its JSON string representation ('true' or 'false').
